description_en: Synchronizes the inter-region bandwidth limits for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 同步专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的各地域之间的转发带宽限制
name: SynchronizeExpressConnectRouterInterRegionBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request. The service resource is not modified.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request and can contain only ASCII characters.

Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsInstanceId, the specified DtsInstanceId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsInstanceId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsInstanceId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

True: The call was successful.

False: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

True：成功。
False：失败
